summary.text: Daniel Joseph Shagoury, a Democrat, represents House District 55 (Hallowell, Manchester and West Gardiner, Kennebec County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Hallowell. The House profile lists membership on the Health and Human Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives retired state employee as the occupation and a B.A. (1982) from Colby College.
It says Shagoury is married, to Juliet, with two children.
